digest_note: sha256_raw is over the bytes CI produced; sha256_canonical_json is over canonical JSON and is the content identity. CI pretty-prints JSON that the repository stores compactly, so the two byte digests of identical content differ — bind the canonical one.
why: GitHub Actions artifacts for this paper's external probes expire on 2026-09-15. Mirrored here so the evidence outlives the CI retention window rather than leaving digests that point at nothing.
